item.title: Fog is possible in Houston Tuesday morning, cool down coming this weekend
item.description: Yeah, it's warm, but we do have a cooldown and some needed rain chances in sight.

item.title: Shelter-in-place lifted after explosion at Valero facility in Port Arthur, police say
item.description: According to Port Arthur police, residents in the city's west side were advised to shelter in place after an explosion occurred at a Valero facility.

item.title: SW Houston homeowner shoots 'bloodied' man who kicked down his door and forced entry, police say
item.description: Houston police say a man with blood on his head was running through the neighborhood with a masked man before he kicked in a door, forced entry, and was shot by the homeowner. According to authorities, the masked man is still at large.

item.title: Precinct 1 deputy injured in crash on IH-69 at Collingsworth, authorities confirm
item.description: Drivers could experience some traffic delays as crews work to clear the scene of a crash involving a Precinct 1 deputy and another vehicle on IH-69 at Collingsworth, authorities said.

item.title: Former Missouri City police officer found guilty in 2024 crash that killed three people
item.description: The former Missouri City police officer was found guilty of three counts of aggravated assault by a public servant in the deadly crash that killed three people in 2024.

item.title: Police say fight over blocked motel doorway led to man dead, another shot in NW Houston
item.description: Police say a man is dead and another is injured after a fight broke out at the Scottish Inn on Antoine in northwest Houston overnight.

item.title: Woman accused of opening fire at Rihanna's home set to appear in court
item.description: A woman charged with trying to murder Rihanna and more than a dozen other felonies is set to appear in court to enter a plea Wednesday.

item.title: United Airlines announces new 'Relax Row' economy seats that convert to a couch
item.description: United Airlines has introduced a new option in economy called the 'Relax Row' with three seats that convert to a pull-out couch with adjustable leg rests.

item.title: Amazon's Big Spring Sale: What you need to know to save big
item.description: Amazon's Big Spring Sale is back! Here's everything you need to know to save big.

item.title: Conroe judge who said 'beware' during DWI arrest pleads guilty, records show
item.description: According to court documents, Judge William Waggoner avoided jail time with this sentence, as he was given one year of community supervision.

item.title: OpenAI pulls the plug on Sora, the viral AI video app that sparked deepfake concerns
item.description: OpenAI said in a brief social media message Tuesday that it was "saying goodbye to the Sora app."

item.title: Literacy Council of Fort Bend County looks to center adult education through digital, ESL programs
item.description: According to the Literacy Council of Fort Bend County, 19% of adults, or about 154,000 - 174,000 people in Fort Bend County, have low literacy skills, meaning they struggle with basic reading and writing.

item.title: Melissa Etheridge, Lauren Alaina and more performing at the 2026 CMA Fest daytime outdoor stages
item.description: Melissa Etheridge, Lauren Alaina, Uncle Kracker and more announced to be performing at the daytime stages for the 2026 CMA Fest!

item.title: Emergency managers could lose access to hurricane evacuation tool when contract lapses
item.description: This is due to a lapse in the federal contract governing the web-based tool known as Hurrevac, which some meteorologists and emergency managers use to make decisions.

item.description: Hoffman spent a year perfecting a glaze formula to incorporate human remains.
